SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM orders;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customers.customer_unique_id) AS musteri_sayisi
FROM customers;

SELECT 
    order_status, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM 
    orders
GROUP BY 
    order_status;

SELECT 
  SUM(order_items.price) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  orders
  JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
WHERE 
  orders.order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM orders.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS ay,
  COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM 
  orders
WHERE 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM orders.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM orders.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY 
  ay;

SELECT 
    p.product_category_name_english AS product_category_name_english,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue
FROM 
    order_items oi
JOIN 
    products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN 
    orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE 
    o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    p.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY 
    total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(DAY FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp))::int AS ortalama_teslim_suresi
FROM 
  orders
WHERE 
  order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS perc_gec_teslimat
FROM 
  orders
JOIN 
  geolocation ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
JOIN 
  customers ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id
WHERE 
  order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT 
    c.customer_state, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS musteri_sayisi
FROM 
    customers c
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_state
ORDER BY 
    musteri_sayisi DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    order_payments.payment_type, 
    SUM(order_payments.payment_value) AS toplam_odenen_tutar
FROM 
    orders
JOIN 
    order_payments ON orders.order_id = order_payments.order_id
WHERE 
    orders.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    order_payments.payment_type;

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM 
  orders
JOIN 
  customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
WHERE 
  orders.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-10-01' 
  AND orders.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-11-01';

SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS ortalama_degerlendirme_puani
FROM 
  order_reviews
JOIN 
  orders ON order_reviews.order_id = orders.order_id
WHERE 
  orders.order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sellers.seller_id)
FROM sellers;

SELECT MAX(price) AS en_pahalı_fiyat
FROM order_items
JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id
WHERE orders.order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT 
    sellers.seller_state, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT sellers.seller_id) AS seller_count
FROM 
    sellers
GROUP BY 
    sellers.seller_state;

SELECT 
  review_score, 
  COUNT(*) AS review_count
FROM 
  order_reviews
GROUP BY 
  review_score
ORDER BY 
  review_score;

SELECT 
    payment_installments, 
    COUNT(*) AS frequency
FROM 
    order_payments
WHERE 
    payment_type = 'credit_card'
GROUP BY 
    payment_installments
ORDER BY 
    frequency DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    COALESCE(c.customer_city, g.geolocation_city) AS city,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN 
    geolocation g ON c.customer_zip_code_prefix = g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
GROUP BY 
    COALESCE(c.customer_city, g.geolocation_city)
ORDER BY 
    order_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    c.customer_state, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS siparis_sayisi, 
    SUM(oi.price) AS ciro, 
    SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS ortalama_sepet
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE 
    o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_state
ORDER BY 
    ortalama_sepet DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    sellers.seller_id,
    SUM(order_items.price) AS ciro
FROM 
    orders
JOIN 
    order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
JOIN 
    sellers ON order_items.seller_id = sellers.seller_id
WHERE 
    orders.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    sellers.seller_id
ORDER BY 
    ciro DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS year,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
  SUM(CASE WHEN orders.order_status = 'delivered' THEN order_items.price ELSE 0 END) AS monthly_revenue
FROM
  orders
JOIN
  order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
WHERE
  order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01'
GROUP BY
  1, 2
ORDER BY
  1, 2;

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(DOW FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS hafta_gunu,
    COUNT(*) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM 
    orders
GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(DOW FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int
ORDER BY 
    siparis_sayisi DESC;

SELECT 
    c.customer_state, 
    MAX(DATEDIFF(day, o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date)) AS teslimat_suresi
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE 
    o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_state
ORDER BY 
    teslimat_suresi DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COUNT(order_id) OVER (PARTITION BY customers.customer_unique_id) >= 2 THEN customers.customer_unique_id END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT customers.customer_unique_id) AS tekrar_eden_musteri_orani
FROM customers
JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id
WHERE orders.order_status = 'delivered';
